title: Champions League: Real Madrid thrash PSV 5-1 in comeback win as Manchester City held by Napoli
summary: Real Madrid extended their winning run to 10 games in all competitions on Tuesday, overturning an early deficit to rout PSV Eindhoven 5-1 in the Champions League, with Jude Bellingham scoring a spectacular goal and Kylian Mbappé netting twice.
